name: Super Search
summary: Search your coding memory. Use when user asks about past work, previous sessions, how something was implemented, what they worked on before, or wants to recall information from earlier sessions.

name: Supermemory
summary: Supermemory is a state-of-the-art memory and context infrastructure for AI agents. Use this skill when building applications that need persistent memory, user personalization, long-term context retention, or semantic search across knowledge bases. It provides Memory API for learned user context, User Profiles for static/dynamic facts, and RAG for semantic search. Perfect for chatbots, assistants, and knowledge-intensive applications.

name: Supermemory Cli
summary: Use the Supermemory CLI to programmatically manage memories, documents, profiles, tags, connectors, keys, and teams from the terminal. Covers all commands, flags, and usage patterns.

name: Svg Animations
summary: Create beautiful, performant SVG animations and illustrations. Use this skill when the user asks to create SVG graphics, icons, illustrations, animated logos, path animations, morphing shapes, loading spinners, or any animated SVG content. Covers SMIL animations, CSS-driven SVG animation, path drawing effects, shape morphing, motion paths, gradients, masks, and filters.
